Re-registered with the correct developer of record (Srijan Upadhyay). Supersedes bti-v3-hgb-20260923160241, whose developer field was a placeholder. Same data, code and seed; all metrics identical.

Remediation of finding: Feature v1 treated customers with no prior history as using a new device, raising false positives for thin-history and new-to-bank customers; legitimate German customers flagged 1.18-1.25x the norm at the 10% stress budget across all seven models (incumbent 1.229x, p=0.037). bti-v3-lgbm-20260923180905 is non-inferior (calibration PR-AUC 0.8524 vs incumbent 0.8507, floor 0.8457) and passes every gate. Selected on the calibration window.

Remediation of finding: Absolute amount features act as a wealth and country proxy: legitimate German customers (median transaction 3x the book, equal fraud rate) flagged ~1.23x the norm at the 10% stress budget in every model (challenger bti-v3-lgbm-20260923180905: 1.228x, p=0.035). bti-v3-xgb-r-20260923181450 is non-inferior (calibration PR-AUC 0.8519 vs incumbent 0.8524, floor 0.8474) and passes every gate. Selected on the calibration window.

Remediation of finding: amount_to_balance compares every customer with one global scale: legitimate Private Banking customers (typical payment 18.7% of balance vs 0.8% for others) are flagged 1.29x the overall rate at the 10% stress budget (pooled, q=0.13, above the norm in both windows; SHAP: amount_to_balance explains 0.21 of a 0.28 log-odds gap). bti-v3-xgb-rn-20260925003533 is non-inferior (calibration PR-AUC 0.8518 vs incumbent 0.8519, floor 0.8469) and passes every gate and the remediation check (the named groups improved and carry no finding). Selected on the calibration window.

Remediation of finding: Missing-input hazard: amount_vs_hist_avg and login_attempts were never missing in training, so a transaction without the customer profile average or login count was routed down an arbitrary tree branch; with either input missing, 100% of genuine customers scored above p=0.5 (incumbent bti-v3-xgb-rn-20260925003533, found in the Phase 2 live smoke run). bti-v3-lgbm-rn-20260925011359 is non-inferior (calibration PR-AUC 0.8506 vs incumbent 0.8518, floor 0.8468) and passes every gate. Selected on the calibration window.

notes.author: bti.modeling.reassess
notes.subject: Correction: German remediation
notes.detail: This model took the challenger role in a remediation tournament for a German false-positive finding. Under the corrected method that finding is a multiple-testing artefact: it appears only in the out-of-time window (calibration 0.92-0.99x, pooled 1.10x, never significant after correction; permutation test 23% by chance). The model is retained on its own merits: it removes absolute-amount features that act as a wealth proxy, at no accuracy cost (OOT PR-AUC 0.8857 vs 0.8856), and it does not carry the Corporate / Private Banking disparity found in its predecessor. Private Banking remains on the watchlist (pooled 1.29x, q 0.13).

notes.author: bti.modeling.reassess
notes.subject: Finding under the corrected method
notes.detail: Registered as passing fairness. Under the pooled, corrected method it has a gating disparity: legitimate Corporate customers flagged 1.27x and Private Banking 1.32x the overall rate at the 10% stress budget (q 0.03, above the overall rate in both windows). Mechanism: absolute USD amounts act as a wealth proxy. Already replaced as challenger by bti-v3-xgb-r-20260923181450, which removes those features.

notes.author: bti.modeling.train (missing-input check)
notes.subject: Finding: missing-input hazard
notes.detail: amount_vs_hist_avg and login_attempts were never missing in training. With either input absent, 100% of a 2,000-customer genuine sample scored above p=0.5 (amount_vs_hist_avg +8.4 log-odds, login_attempts +6.8). Found in the Phase 2 live smoke run, where transactions without the profile average all scored 0.97. Replaced as challenger by bti-v3-lgbm-rn-20260925011359, trained with missingness augmentation and checked by the new missing_input_robustness gate (worst increase 0.05%).
